problem.title: Minimum Operations to Sort A Permutation

approaches.title: Validate consecutive runs and derive the operation count
approaches.summary: Check whether the permutation forms the required ascending or descending consecutive runs, then use the relevant boundary position to compute the minimum operations. The later revision replaces allocated run-length lists with direct checks around the position of zero.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Build ascending and descending consecutive-run lengths, handle the fully ordered cases, and use the run boundary to calculate the operation count.
Find zero and check continuity on the slices around it without allocating run-length vectors; compute the result from zero’s position.
